name: trx local MP4 transcription on Windows

argv: $tarball = Get-ChildItem -Path . -Filter 'trx.tgz' -Recurse | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $tarball) { Write-Error 'trx.tgz not found'; exit 1 }; & bun add --global $tarball.FullName; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
$result = & trx init --yes --backend local --model tiny --language en --output json; $code = $LASTEXITCODE; $result | Set-Content -Encoding utf8 'trx-windows-evidence/init.json'; $result; exit $code
$result = & trx doctor --output json; $code = $LASTEXITCODE; $result | Set-Content -Encoding utf8 'trx-windows-evidence/doctor.json'; $result; exit $code

Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Speech; Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing; $root = (Resolve-Path 'trx-windows-evidence').Path; $wav = Join-Path $root 'spoken-source.wav'; $frame = Join-Path $root 'mp4-frame.png'; $mp4 = Join-Path $root 'spoken.mp4'; $voice = New-Object System.Speech.Synthesis.SpeechSynthesizer; $voice.SetOutputToWaveFile($wav); $voice.Speak('TRX really transcribed this MP4 video on Windows'); $voice.Dispose(); $bitmap = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap 1280,720; $graphics = [System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($bitmap); $graphics.Clear([System.Drawing.Color]::FromArgb(11,18,32)); $font = New-Object System.Drawing.Font('Arial',42,[System.Drawing.FontStyle]::Bold); $brush = New-Object System.Drawing.SolidBrush([System.Drawing.Color]::White); $graphics.DrawString('TRX REAL MP4 WINDOWS TEST',$font,$brush,120,310); $bitmap.Save($frame,[System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Png); $brush.Dispose(); $font.Dispose(); $graphics.Dispose(); $bitmap.Dispose(); $doctor = Get-Content 'trx-windows-evidence/doctor.json' -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $ffmpeg = $doctor.dependencies.ffmpeg.path; & $ffmpeg -loop 1 -i $frame -i $wav -c:v libx264 -tune stillimage -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -shortest $mp4 -y; exit $LASTEXITCODE

$doctor = Get-Content 'trx-windows-evidence/doctor.json' -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $ffprobe = Join-Path (Split-Path $doctor.dependencies.ffmpeg.path) 'ffprobe.exe'; $result = & $ffprobe -v error -show_entries 'stream=index,codec_type,codec_name:format=filename,format_name,duration' -of json 'trx-windows-evidence/spoken.mp4'; $code = $LASTEXITCODE; $result | Set-Content -Encoding utf8 'trx-windows-evidence/mp4-probe.json'; $result; exit $code

$result = & trx transcribe 'trx-windows-evidence/spoken.mp4' --backend local --language en --output-dir 'trx-windows-evidence/output' --output json; $code = $LASTEXITCODE; $result | Set-Content -Encoding utf8 'trx-windows-evidence/transcription.json'; $result; exit $code

steps.expected: TRX really transcribed this MP4 video on Windows

argv: $doctor = Get-Content 'trx-windows-evidence/doctor.json' -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $probe = Get-Content 'trx-windows-evidence/mp4-probe.json' -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $run = Get-Content 'trx-windows-evidence/transcription.json' -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $video = $probe.streams | Where-Object { $_.codec_type -eq 'video' } | Select-Object -First 1; $audio = $probe.streams | Where-Object { $_.codec_type -eq 'audio' } | Select-Object -First 1; $transcript = (Get-Content -LiteralPath $run.files.txt -Raw).Trim(); @('TRX REAL MP4 END-TO-END PROOF', ('Input: ' + $run.input), ('Backend: ' + $run.backend), ('Whisper: ' + $doctor.dependencies.'whisper-cli'.path), ('MP4 streams: video=' + $video.codec_name + ', audio=' + $audio.codec_name), ('Transcript file: ' + $run.files.txt), 'TRANSCRIPT READ FROM FILE:', $transcript) | Set-Content -Encoding utf8 'trx-windows-evidence/proof.txt'
$targets = Get-Process cmd -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.MainWindowTitle -eq 'trx-windows-proof' }; if ($targets) { $targets | Stop-Process -Force }; exit 0
